document.description: Valid Canadian visas can unlock visa-free or simplified access beyond passport privileges

unlocks.conditions: Hold a Canadian visa valid on the day of entry into Georgia and present the travel and/or other appropriate document proving its validity. Visa-free stays are limited to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.

source.verificationPath: Legislative Herald of Georgia > Ordinance No 256 of 5 June 2015 > annex, Canada (item 22), and Notes 1-2
source.exactQuote: Aliens holding a visa and/or a residence permit of any country listed in the annex may enter and stay in Georgia without visa for 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.
source.validityQuote: For the purpose of entering and staying in Georgia without visa, a visa and/or a residence permit of a respective country shall be valid on the day of entry into Georgia (crossing the border), which must be evidenced by a travel and/or other appropriate document.
source.notes: The English page is the initial edition. Checked against the MFA-hosted Georgian consolidated text and the listed 17 April 2025 amendment; that amendment adds conditions for specified Gulf-state documents, not Canadian visas.

currentTextSource.verificationPath: MFA legal-act PDF > page 2, Canada (item 22); page 3, entry conditions 1-3

amendmentSource.verificationPath: Ordinance No 122 of 17 April 2025 > Article 1, addition of condition 3

unlocks.notes: This entry covers Canadian visas. The 90-day allowance is cumulative within any 180 days, not a fresh 90 days per entry. It does not establish permission to work, study or reside in Georgia; other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa. The Belize entry-visa exemption is for visits not exceeding 30 days; a single-entry Canadian visa does not meet the stated exemption.

source.verificationPath: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do you need a visa to travel to Belize? > Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days
source.exactQuote: If you hold a valid multiple entry visa or Permanent Residence Card from Canada
source.maximumStayQuote: Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days.
source.notes: The source lists a valid Canadian multiple-entry visa or Canadian Permanent Residence Card as alternative qualifying documents in the same bullet; this entry records only the visa route. The exemption list does not impose a passport-nationality restriction.

unlocks.notes: This entry covers the Canadian multiple-entry visa exemption, not permanent residence or Canadian eTA. A visa waiver does not waive other admission requirements or guarantee 30 days. Staying beyond the initial 30 days requires the appropriate Belize visitor permit extension.
